_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, manufacturing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services for many different types of computing devices'; 'The cloud-based computing model presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Challenges to our business models may reduce our revenues or operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2010 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, manufacturing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services for many different types of computing devices'; 'The cloud-based computing model presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Challenges to our business models may reduce our revenues or operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2010 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.21x; -8% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.98; conservative 2yr +96%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.4%/yr (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.5%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.5%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2011-07-08) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.21x (55.4% downside to Bear $12 / +260.3% upside to Bull $97) | Adj composite 2.42 vs market 1.44: gap +0.98 [UNDERVALUED] | -8% above the EPP floor $29 (14x FY11E $2.10) | Conservative 2-yr case: +95.8% total (+47.9%/yr) | At 12.8x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $36 sits at or below the BASE case; unearned revenue +6.2% in Q3 FY11, forward revenues +13% (no Q4 FY11 revenue guide, Q3 FY11 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
